exact.correction_polynomial: Put B=alpha'(s)t^2/8, a_0=1+1/(6s)+alpha'(s)t/4+B alpha(s)^2, a_1=-2B alpha(s), and a_2=B. Then, exactly, 1+d_n=a_0+a_1 log(n)+a_2 log(n)^2.

exact.legacy_distinction: The exact first-jet symmetry is multiplicative and hyperbolically truncated: dm<=N with additive weight Lambda(d)+Lambda(m).
